verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade autos near her Tentacles while her E is up; you win by timing Q/W all-ins to her E cooldown and using R to drag her away from her Tentacle zone once it's online at 6.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) plus passive Tentacles on nearby terrain mean every extended trade compounds in her favor and heals her, while Sett has no sustained trade tool before level 6. Sett's edge is short, decisive windows: his passive regen scales off missing health and his W banks Grit from damage taken, so he wants brief all-ins timed to her Test of Spirit cooldown rather than standing exchanges.

theirWindow.when: Her E is up near tentacles
theirWindow.what: She can rip your spirit with Test of Spirit, letting nearby Tentacles swing at you for free damage and healing her off the hit; if the spirit dies or gets too far from you, you become a Vessel that spawns more Tentacles. Back off or fight elsewhere until it's down.

yourWindow.what: Step in with Q (Knuckle Down) for bonus max-health damage on your next two hits, or commit a full all-in using W's banked Grit shield and true-damage center punch, since she has no spirit tool to punish the engage.

powerCurve.note: Her W poke beats your early trades.
Facebreaker only slows without a second body.
R lets you threaten kills off tentacles.
Shorter cooldowns and Stridebreaker close the gap.
Tentacles still punish overstaying in extended fights.

start.why: The highest-performing start in these games (53.7% WR, 78.9% pick); the lifesteal and extra HP absorb her W/Q poke so you aren't ceding sustain for free before you have Q online as a trade tool.

boots.why: The standard pick (45.9% WR, 80.4% pick); flat physical damage reduction directly blunts her autos, Tentacle swings, and W/Q procs, which are all she has to punish you with before her E lands.

core.why: Gives you the slow proc and move speed to actually stick a trade or disengage before Tentacles pile on; part of the 60% win-rate path over 10 games.
Armor shred lets your short Q/W trade windows do more before she can reset behind a Tentacle swing.
Health and damage scaling that rewards the extended fights you'll be forced into once Tentacles are spawned.

situational.when: she's all-inning you or focusing you down in skirmishes
she's stacking health and out-sustaining your trades
fights go long and you're cycling Q/W/E repeatedly
you need to kite out of her Tentacle zone instead of tanking through it

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the sustained damage Tentacles and her autos put on you, then converts to healing at max stacks, which directly counters the attrition she's trying to win.

summoners.why: The dominant pick in these games (47.8% WR, 92% pick); Ignite's Grievous Wounds cuts the healing she gets off Tentacle swings during your all-in windows, which is the single biggest lever you have on her sustain.

playing.title: Time all-ins to her E cooldown
playing.detail: Only commit to an extended trade when Test of Spirit (16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) is down; if it's up she can rip your spirit and stack free Tentacle swings onto you while poking with W.

playing.title: Facebreaker needs a second body
playing.detail: E (Facebreaker) only stuns when enemies sit on opposite sides of you; in a clean 1v1 it will just slow her, so pull her onto a minion or wait for wave contact before expecting the stun.

playing.title: Let her hit you before W
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) passively banks Grit from damage taken, so absorbing a few of her autos or Tentacle swings before casting it maximizes the shield and the true-damage center hit.

playing.title: Avoid trading near terrain
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassable terrain that swing at you and heal her on hit; back off wall-adjacent spots during longer exchanges.

playing.title: Use R to pull her off tentacles
playing.detail: The Show Stopper (120/100/80/80/80s cooldown) carries her through the air to a new spot; landing it away from her Tentacle zone strips her sustain and opens a real kill window.

playing.title: Punish with Q, not sustained autos
playing.detail: Knuckle Down's bonus max-health damage on your next two attacks rewards short, decisive trades over standing and trading autos where her Tentacles accumulate in her favor.

playing.title: Ignite denies her sustain
playing.detail: Flash+Ignite cuts the healing she gets from landing Tentacle swings on you during all-ins, which is often the difference in a close trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner numbers are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the matchup, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get hit by Illaoi’s (E) in lane. Use your skills off cooldown to fight her while focusing on landing them successfully.
